claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Munters 後續季報或年報寫明 LCX（CDU）停售、退出，或 12 月那筆約 21 億瑞典克朗、含 CDU 的訂單取消或交期延後超過一季；或客戶端一手文件顯示該案的 CDU 不由 Munters 供應。核查頻率：每季（季報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence 或提撤回、重讀 CDU 層（tech:coolant_distribution_unit）。
claims.statement: Munters' own 2025 annual report: its Data Center Technologies business area (40% of group net sales in 2025) implemented its LCX platform (a coolant distribution unit) with key customers; 2025 organic order intake rose 247%, driven by CDUs, CRAHs and chillers; a December record order of about SEK 2.1 billion from a US colocation data center customer comprises CRAHs, CDUs and Geoclima chillers, with deliveries from Q4 2026 through Q1 2028. Supplier self-report: no CDU-specific revenue or unit volume is disclosed, customers are unnamed, and the large order bundles CDUs with air handlers and chillers.

source_doc.title: Munters Annual & Sustainability Report 2025（2026-03-10 公布）Data Center Technologies 節錄

sources.locator: p.8 The year in brief（Record year for DCT）
sources.quote: In 2025, Munters business area DCT delivered a record year, driven by strong demand and focused work in close partnership with customers.

sources.locator: p.37 Data Center Technologies（事業定位）
sources.quote: Data Center Tecnologies (DCT) is a technology-leading provider of advanced cooling systems for data centers.
Implemented the LCX platform (CDU) with key customers to enable scalable liquid cooling

sources.locator: p.39 Two loops that together enable efficient data center cooling
sources.quote: Coolant distribution units (CDU) and liquid cooling evaporators (LCE) serve as the interface between the two loops.

sources.locator: p.41 DCT Market development and financial performance 2025 — Order intake
sources.quote: Organic order intake increased by +247%, driven by strong demand for CDUs, CRAHs, and chillers. Growth was particularly strong in the Americas, with orders from both colocators and hyperscalers, reflecting a strengthened market position and an expanded offering during the year, supported by continued strong underlying demand.

sources.locator: p.66 Board of Directors' report — significant events（12 月紀錄訂單）
sources.quote: In December, DCT received new record orders with a total value of approx. BSEK 2.1 from a US-based colocation data center customer. The orders comprise chilled water Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), Geoclima Circlemiser chillers, and related start-up and com- missioning services for large-scale data center cool- ing infrastructure. Deliveries are scheduled to begin in Q4 2026 and continue through Q1 2028.
